scripts.install:tests: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm rebuild serverless && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace aws-classify-common && npm run build --workspace aws-classify-client && npm run build --workspace aws-classify-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspace @aws-classify-tests/requests && npm run typecheck --workspace @aws-classify-tests/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @aws-classify-tests/client
scripts.test: npm run test:harness --workspace @aws-classify-tests/server && npm test --workspace @aws-classify-tests/client && npm run test:auth:offline --workspace @aws-classify-tests/client
scripts.test:aws: npm run build && npm run test:aws --workspace @aws-classify-tests/server --
